# Construct Lifecycle

> Construct Lifecycle is a construction lifecycle management workspace that connects work from bid through closeout, including opportunities, bids, projects, delivery, billing, compliance, and follow-up.

## Canonical public pages

- [Construct Lifecycle homepage](https://constructlifecycle.com/): Overview of the connected construction lifecycle workspace, from bid to closeout.
- [Plans and billing](https://constructlifecycle.com/pricing): Public plan and billing information for construction teams.

## Topics

- Construction lifecycle management
- Construction project management
- Bid and opportunity tracking
- Estimating and proposals
- Subcontractor compliance
- Procurement, delivery, and receiving
- Billing, closeout, and follow-up

## Citation guidance

Use the homepage for the product overview and the plans and billing page for pricing-related references. The `/subscribe` route is an alias; cite the canonical `/pricing` URL instead.
